svg.title: Continuous verification, independent closure
svg.desc: Main manages requirements, dispatch, and process alongside a persistent Verifier. Designer supplies architecture, Workers implement, and Verifier inspects, integrates, tests, and repairs every actual change. A separate Reviewer closes immutable milestones while other work continues. After all Workers and milestone-review repair writes finish and corrected revisions are incorporated, Verifier performs final regression, notifies Main, and is stopped before a separate final Reviewer closes all requirements from requirements and code.

g.text: Requirements + immutable code candidate → independent validation, repairs, and closure
Verifier continues other work outside the candidate. Review repairs return for integration.
All Workers done → Verifier final regression → notify Main → Main stops Verifier
→ Separate final Reviewer: independently validate, repair, and close every requirement
